citation.authors: Stadler M, Anderwald C, Pacini G, Zbýň Š, Promintzer-Schifferl M, Mandl M, Bischof M, Gruber S, Nowotny P, Luger A, Prager R, Krebs M
citation.title: Chronic Peripheral Hyperinsulinemia in Type 1 Diabetic Patients After Successful Combined Pancreas-Kidney Transplantation Does Not Affect Ectopic Lipid Accumulation in Skeletal Muscle and Liver

population.description: Nine nondiabetic control subjects (3 F / 6 M), called healthy ('healthy control subjects') and matched for age and BMI to the pancreas-kidney transplant recipients; screened by nondiabetic fasting plasma glucose and A1C < 6.5% (Methods). Age 53 +/- 9 y and BMI 26 +/- 2 kg/m2 as printed in Table 1 (means +/- SD). The type 1 diabetic transplant group is left out.

protocols.name: fasting_controls
protocols.description: Control subjects, fasting, no meal, no drink, no infusion the model reads; the stable-isotope tracer (d-[6,6-2H2]glucose) is a measurement, not an input. Primed continuous tracer infusion: 5 min priming then 115 min continuous (Methods), 120 min in all, so the arm starts with the tracer and runs 120 min; EGP was calculated from blood samples 'taken after 2 h of steady-state infusion', read here at minute 120 (the end of the infusion; the paper prints no sampling minutes). The state is 'fasting EGP'; the hours fasted and the clock time are not printed for this study, so a 10 h overnight fast and 08:00 are assumed.

protocols.name: fasted_morning_controls
protocols.description: Control subjects, basal samples of the OGTT day, taken after an overnight fast ('An oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) was performed after an overnight fast. After the collection of basal samples, participants were given ... 75 g glucose'); no food. Hours fasted not printed beyond 'overnight', so 10 h assumed; 08:00 and a 30 min arm assumed, the basal value read at the end of the arm.

protocols.name: ogtt_controls
protocols.description: Control subjects, 75 g glucose in water (Glukodrink) given within 5 min after the basal sample at minute 0 (Methods), 75 g carbohydrate, bed rest; samples at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, 120, 150 and 180 min. Fasted overnight (stated as overnight; 10 h assumed). Start hour not printed; 08:00 assumed.
